question: How was Entei ex's 60-damage Blazing Beatdown made up (was its extra-damage condition met), and what does Training Area boost: a Basic ex like Entei ex, or an opponent's Stage 1 like Ivysaur?
what_to_record: Nothing new. The printed card text answers both parts. If someone wants to confirm, the existing 023151 frames at about 310-315 s should show Entei ex with 2 Fire Energy and no bonus.
why: Already settled by card text (lib/card.py). Blazing Beatdown (A4a 010) does 60, plus 60 more only with at least 2 extra Fire beyond its Fire-Fire cost (4 Fire in all). So 60 on 2 visible Fire means the condition was not met. Training Area (B2 153) boosts only attacks by Stage 1 Pokemon, 'both yours and your opponent's', and only against the Active. Entei ex is a Basic, so it gets nothing, and an opposing Ivysaur does get +10. rules/04 §6 (Stadiums) already records Training Area boosting an opponent's Stage 1. Engine: engine_matches. Blazing Beatdown needs its cost plus 2 extra Fire (engine/src/actions/effect_mechanic_map.rs:1333-1338; engine/src/actions/apply_attack_action.rs:3254-3281). Training Area checks only stage == 1 and has no owner check (engine/src/stadiums.rs:129-137). It applies only Active-to-Active (engine/src/hooks/core.rs:1817-1832). Tests: engine/tests/stadiums/stadium_test.rs:382 (no bonus for a Basic) and :683 (both players' Stage 1 get it).

question: Victini's Victory Star: does a worse reroll stand, how often can it be used, does Ability suppression stop it, and does it work with Confusion (on the Confusion flip itself, or on the attack's own coins after the Confusion flip is Heads)?
what_to_record: Only the Confusion part is open. Needed: Victini in play and a Confused Fire Active using a coin-flip attack. Record whether the game offers Victory Star (a) on the Confusion flip and (b) on the attack's own coins after the Confusion flip comes up Heads. The opponent has to Confuse him, so this needs a friend battle or ladder luck. Low priority: only Fire decks running Victini care.
why: The rest is settled by card text (B3 025): 'ignore all results ... begin flipping those coins again', once per turn, and no more than 1 Victory Star per turn. So the new batch stands even if it is worse. rules/04 §9 (observed 020124, 014933) agrees: the reroll replaces the whole batch. Engine, for those parts: engine_matches. The worse reroll is binding (engine/tests/victini_victory_star_test.rs:189). It is one use per turn (:251). It needs a Fire Active and the in-play, suppression-aware Ability lookup (engine/src/actions/apply_action.rs:167-181). Confusion: the engine switches Victory Star off entirely when the attacker is Confused (engine/src/actions/apply_action.rs:195-202; engine/src/actions/apply_attack_action.rs:94-108; test engine/tests/victini_victory_star_test.rs:341). engine/src/card_validation.rs:96-98 flags this as pending verification. For part (b) that is engine_contradicts the card text, because the attack's own coins are plainly 'coins for an attack'. It is a documented limitation in the code, but not on the rules/ known-bug list. Part (a) is cannot_determine until seen in the game.

question: Are 145205's other first-pass (Gemini) facts right: Random Spark hitting the Bench, Electric Generator on Tails, Electro Ball's +20 Weakness, Turbo Shark's no-target message, and the first-turn restrictions?
what_to_record: No new recording. Frame checks of the existing video (00:30-00:54, 02:17-02:28, 02:44-02:47, 03:13-03:15) if the ledger needs them.
why: All settled by card text or rules; confirming them is bookkeeping. Random Spark (Team Rocket's Electrode B4a 020) does 30 to any one opposing Pokemon, Bench included, with no Weakness on the Bench (rules/02 §2). Electric Generator (B2a 086) attaches only on Heads. Turbo Shark attaches only to a Benched Water Pokemon, so with none it does nothing, and the app says so. First-turn rules: rules/README.md item 6. Engine: engine_matches. Weakness applies only Active-to-Active (engine/src/hooks/core.rs:1787-1793, 1876-1880). Turbo Shark with no target silently skips (engine/src/actions/apply_attack_action.rs:2337-2344).
